CC0-1.0 authored two-page 10x10 PDF: opaque red then opaque green. Isolated hayro 0.7.1 and Poppler agree exactly on opaque page samples; ordinary viewer integration and wider qualification pending.
red-alpha.pdf is CC0-authored: one 10x10 red fill with ExtGState ca/CA 0.5. Native straight RGBA [255,0,0,128]; Poppler white RGB [255,127,127], full plane exact.
cairo-text-shapes.svg/pdf are CC0-authored; Cairo-generated PDF reads, but exact Poppler comparison fails (173/1728 pixels). No full qualification claim.
cairo-{rect,circle,triangle,text}.svg/pdf isolate components of the combined image. Rectangle is Poppler-exact; curved/diagonal/text comparisons fail exact equality. cairo-rect.rgba is the opaque Poppler oracle for the authored rectangle.
cairo-text-shapes-large.svg/pdf are CC0-authored scaled versions (1536x1152 rendered at 72 dpi); timing fixture, full pixel qualification pending.
rotate90.pdf/rgba are CC0-authored: 10x20 media box rotated 90 degrees, 20x10 output with opaque red left/green right halves; native and Poppler full plane match.
geometry-*.pdf are CC0-authored reproducible page-geometry cases. UserUnit reference uses specification scale (20x40), while pinned Poppler 72dpi ignored UserUnit.
device-cmyk-patches.pdf is CC0-authored: five 10x10 DeviceCMYK vector fills in a 50x10 page, cyan/magenta/yellow/black and mixed [0.2,0.4,0.6,0.1]. No embedded ICC profile. Flat-center native/Poppler RGB differences are recorded in docs/research/pdf-device-cmyk-2026-10-06.json; this is a negative color-conversion diagnostic, not a qualified pixel oracle.
corrupt-embedded-jpeg.pdf is CC0-authored: a valid PDF object graph draws a 1x1 DCTDecode image containing invalid JPEG bytes. It must return an explicit embedded-image failure, not publish the renderer's incomplete blank page; all managed reservations must be released.
unsupported-font.pdf is CC0-authored: the page selects /F0 whose font subtype is /UnsupportedKind. Font preflight must refuse it before reserving render outputs. Malformed implementations of otherwise known subtypes remain unqualified.
nested-unsupported-font.pdf, nested-inherited-font.pdf and cyclic-form.pdf are CC0-authored. Invoked forms inherit the page's font/XObject resources: unknown subtype refuses, Helvetica renders visible text, self-reference refuses at the depth limit before output reservation. This does not qualify Type3 glyph programs, patterns or annotation appearance streams.
